input.decision: Stage: the landlord is handling this repair through his own plumber, and we are now checking it is done before close-out. Rules: PM-AUTH-004, PM-DATA-002, PM-CLOSE-001, PM-DOC-001. In event 018 the landlord said his plumber fixed the fault on 14 May. That is based only on a text from the plumber: there is no work note and no record of boiler or electrical checks. The tenant has not confirmed the fix since the voicemail and email on 15 May (events 019 and 020). The last word from the tenant was that nothing had been done (events 012 and 017). So the case cannot close yet. I have emailed the tenant, with an SMS pointing her to it, asking whether the boiler has power and the hot water is back. I have also told her the letterbox does not need a separate report. I have emailed the landlord to say we are checking with the tenant and to ask for the plumber's note of what was found. In the same email I passed on the letterbox report (event 017, never raised with him until now) with the standard question: our contractor or his own? The case is on hold for the tenant until 19/05. If she says hot water is still off, we tell Ravi and arrange our contractor, as he allowed in event 015 and asked for in event 018. If she has not replied by then, we call her.
